entities.summary: Mykola Mykhailovych Ovcharov is a Ukrainian orator, lecturer and researcher of oratorical art as well as a Latin translator, film director and media artist. He is the author of the contemporary rhetoric manual Master of Public Speaking, and other publications on ethics and philosophy. He also edits the scholarly magazine Unknown Orator.
